t: Idiopathic Thrombocytopenic Purpura | Johns Hopkins Medicine
s: July 29, 2024 - Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) is a blood disorder characterized by a decrease in the number of platelets in the blood. Platelets are cells in the blood that help stop bleeding. A decrease in platelets can cause easy bruising, bleeding gums, and internal bleeding.
